title: Bootstrap Knowledge Graph Curator Agent v0.1
reason: As projects generate more evidence and cross-project requests, the Knowledge Graph needs a bounded coherence agent that detects graph inconsistencies and provenance/schema problems.
requested_change: Implement KG Curator Agent v0.1 following docs/architecture/KG_CURATOR_AGENT.md. Inspect KG governance, schemas, canonical exports, KXF validation and source-of-truth checks first. Reuse authoritative validation surfaces. Add persistent stable finding fingerprints, supported checks for broken references and schema drift, provenance-gap checks where provenance is already required, conservative duplicate/conflict candidates where semantics are explicit, deduplication, cooldown and existing-task checks. Promoted findings become valid KUEPER outbox envelopes with evidence and target ownership. Include deterministic tests for a valid case, a broken-reference/schema case and duplicate finding collapse. Keep expensive semantic/full-graph analysis cost-aware and deferable off-peak.
expected_result: The Knowledge Graph has a persistent curator foundation that detects supported coherence, schema and provenance problems, deduplicates findings and emits evidence-backed review or repair requests through the KUEPER loop.
